newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Aug industrial turnover down 6.6 pct yr-yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy Aug industrial turnover down 6.6 pct yr-yr.

text.p: Italian industrial turnover fell 6.6 percent year-on-year in August while orders fell 6.5 percent, national statistics institute Istat said.
Year on year change -6.6 pct +4.4 pct +17.6 pct
Year on year change -6.5 pct -0.8 pct +7.7 pct

Note: Istat said the fall in turnover was especially marked in metal production (-22.0 percent) and in the paper industry (-18.9 percent), while sales climbed 7.3 percent in the mechanical machinery sector and 2.6 percent in the oil industry.
For orders there was a 14.2 percent increase in the transport industry and a 3.0 percent climb in the mechanical machinery sector.
Over the first 8 months of 1996, industrial turnover rose 0.6 percent with orders falling 4.0 percent. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
